structured.approach: DS-03 asks me to confirm that any required database changes are done. I read both contracted inputs. In feat.design I checked whether the HLD/LLD adds storage, migrations or new technology (sections A1, A5, A7, A8, B2). In feat.tasks I checked the scope of the two ap_forecast tasks, TSK-03 and TSK-04. I then checked the ap_forecast checkout against the tool view: a case-insensitive search for database, SQL and migration terms, plus a read of predict.py, explain.py, __init__.py and the .codegraph/.gitignore. My shell command was denied by the G9 hook, so I used Read, Grep and Glob instead. All sources agree that no database change is required. The output records this as an empty change list with evidence, so the outcome is met.

claims.text: The design puts storage, database and schema migration out of scope. The only data changes are one new record key paid_date, one new reject reason, in-memory structures and the CT-1 JSON.
DD-1: no new repository, service, runtime, library or storage. Only the Python 3.9 standard library and Node.js 22 CommonJS are used.
Every new function is pure and in-memory, with no I/O, no network and no mutation of inputs (NF-10). Any storage or network call from the libraries would re-trigger DES-01.

The Data Science lane covers TSK-03 (new risk.py, __init__.py export and version step, new tests/test_risk.py) and TSK-04 (explain.py with risk=None, tests/test_forecast.py). models.json must not change.
ap_forecast has no database; no migrations exist or are required.
ap_forecast reads persistent data only from the models.json configuration through load_config. predict_delay_days computes the rounded mean of the history in memory.
The .codegraph/ database is a local code index that git ignores. It is not an application database.
The required database change list for ap_forecast is empty, so DS-03's outcome is met and nothing waits on infra or DBAs.

structured.summary: No database changes are needed for the Data Science lane (ap_forecast) of FEAT-ZD-48600, so none are outstanding. The design rules out storage and migrations (A1, DD-1, NF-10, A8). TSK-03 and TSK-04 only add pure in-memory code and leave models.json unchanged. The repository view and my checks of the code confirm that ap_forecast has no database. I wrote task.db_changes.md with an empty change list and the evidence for it. DS-04 and DS-05 can go ahead, and nothing waits on infra or DBAs. There are no blocking questions.

tool_input.command: cat src/ap_forecast/predict.py src/ap_forecast/explain.py src/ap_forecast/__init__.py src/ap_forecast/models.json && cat .codegraph/.gitignore; git check-ignore -v .codegraph/codegraph.db; git ls-files
